review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v1 (PSV-E051), the GOAT entry's exact text; the v0 -> v1 change ('your monster ... to the Graveyard' -> 'a monster ... to your Graveyard') is within the same set (Pharaoh's Servant) and predates the baseline, so it is not recorded. Trailing v2 -> v3 (SBLS-EN044, 2019-03-28, the pinned cdb text) is cosmetic PSCT: 'even during the Damage Step' restates DT01's parenthetical, and 'Select and destroy 1 monster on the field' -> 'Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it' is not a targeting change, since EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET is present in both scripts. Worth noting for format computation: DT01-EN096's earliest TCG date (2010-01-29) falls before the Edison snapshot (2010-04-24) and after GOAT (2005-04-01), so the two formats land on opposite sides of this change.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the added Damage Step permission (DT01-EN096, Duel Terminal 1)

event.historical_text: You can activate this card when a monster is sent from the field to your Graveyard. Destroy 1 monster on the field.
event.modern_text: Activate only when a monster is sent from the field to your Graveyard. Select and destroy 1 monster on the field. (You can activate this card during the Damage Step.)
event.summary: Functional change carried by a printing: DT01-EN096 added '(You can activate this card during the Damage Step.)', and the modern script grants EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP on the activation effect. The GOAT variant's only difference from modern is that it omits that flag, setting EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET alone, so the era card cannot be activated during the Damage Step at all - a monster sent from the field to your Graveyard by battle gives it no activation window. Upstream's note: 'Cannot be activated during the damage step.' Everything else (the EVENT_TO_GRAVE activation trigger and the targeted destruction) is byte-identical.
